name: gentle-kiss-turquoise-shallows
image_purpose: couple lifestyle and travel social visual

prompt.project_info: Ultra-photorealistic candid couple portrait in the turquoise shallows of Akyaka-Gokova.
prompt.main_subject: Two approved adults in chest-deep clear turquoise water sharing a brief gentle kiss; ordinary natural faces, wet hair, realistic skin texture, woman in a simple solid-color swimsuit and man in simple swim shorts, both without logos.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 9:16 medium close shot from shallow water, couple slightly off-center, faces sharp, waterline and distant pine hills and rocky edges visible, no beach-club or luxury-boat elements.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright midday natural sun with sky fill, controlled water highlights, detailed soft shadows, sincere effortless PG-13 romantic atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: 35mm equivalent handheld documentary look, crisp but natural detail, subtle 35mm grain, realistic caustics, wet skin sheen and droplets, no HDR or artificial glow.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a vertical 9:16 ultra-photorealistic candid travel photograph of two approved adults standing chest-deep in clear turquoise water at Akyaka-Gokova, sharing a brief gentle PG-13 kiss, wet hair and natural skin texture, woman in a simple solid-color swimsuit and man in simple swim shorts, pine hills and rocky cove behind, bright midday sun, realistic water caustics, handheld 35mm documentary feel, no logos or luxury elements.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, nudity, minors, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, malformed faces, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR, AI glow, watermark, logo overlay
